{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Filter out rows with missing body_mass_g
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = filtered_df['body_mass_g'].mean()

# Also compute and print the number of rows in the filtered dataset
n_rows = len(filtered_df)

print(f"Number of penguins after removing missing body_mass_g: {n_rows}")
print(f"Mean body mass: {mean_body_mass}")"}
